Job title demographics

1-to-1 ABM job titles

Titles, rolled up across all 1-to-1 ad sets

Shares are of job-title impressions. LinkedIn counts a person under every title they hold, so title impressions oversum delivered impressions. Est. $ allocates this window's actual 1-to-1 spend by those shares.

Red rows are non-Marketing, non-Sales, non-RevOps titles, the main exclusion candidates. Marketing and Sales titles are not flagged. Clicks at the title level are often suppressed by LinkedIn.

By campaign group

Groups are ordered by spend. For the last 7 days, each group also has its own rolled-up title list. Campaign-by-campaign cards are omitted on purpose; titles are rolled up, which is how these 1-to-1 reports have been built.

Chili Piper LinkedIn Ads account 507701568. Scope is ad sets whose names start with "1 to 1". Only ad sets that delivered impressions or sends in the selected window are included. Est. $ is a modeled allocation of actual spend by title-impression share, and it can overstate reach because a person is counted under every title they hold. LinkedIn demographic data can lag a day, so the most recent day may be light. Built November 20, 2026.
